standard.summary: 分阶段分辨率训练：控制在各个分辨率级别（512/768/1024/1536/2048）上分配的训练比例，先低分辨率后高分辨率循序渐进。
standard.effect: 设置各分辨率的比例后，训练在不同分辨率下循环，先以低分辨率快速学习全局特征，再以高分辨率精炼细节。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。希望在有限步数内兼顾全局结构和细节质量时可以尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认单一固定分辨率对大多数 LoRA 训练已经足够；分阶段分辨率实现复杂，效果需要实验验证。

standard_en.summary: Staged-resolution training: it controls the share of training allocated to each resolution level (512/768/1024/1536/2048), progressing from low resolution to high.
standard_en.effect: With the ratios set, training cycles through the resolutions: it learns global features quickly at low resolution first, then refines detail at high resolution.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth trying when you want both global structure and detail quality within a limited step count.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A single fixed resolution is already enough for most LoRA training; staged resolution is complex to implement and its benefit needs experimental confirmation.

advanced.principle: 按照配置的比例，每步从不同分辨率 bucket 采样：ratio_512=0.3, ratio_1024=0.7 意味着 30% 步骤用 512 分辨率，70% 用 1024。低分辨率步骤更快（显存占用低），高分辨率步骤更慢但细节更丰富。
advanced.tradeoffs: 分阶段分辨率需要所有分辨率的 bucket 预先生成，增加初始化时间；低分辨率训练的梯度对高分辨率特征的作用有限。

advanced_en.principle: Per the configured ratios, each step samples from a different resolution bucket: ratio_512=0.3, ratio_1024=0.7 means 30% of steps use 512 resolution and 70% use 1024. Low-resolution steps are faster (lower VRAM use), high-resolution steps slower but richer in detail.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Staged resolution requires buckets for all resolutions to be pre-generated, increasing initialization time; gradients from low-resolution training have limited effect on high-resolution features.
